app-del-removed.title: Runbook: use app.delete(...) directly, the real method app.del() only ever aliased

req-param-removed.title: Runbook: read the value directly off req.params (plural), req.body, or req.query, whichever one the removed method used to check for this call site, a source edit that also makes explicit which source the value actually came from

bare-wildcard-removed.title: Runbook: name the wildcard segment (*splat, or any other name), path-to-regexp v8's real required syntax, a source edit to the route string

optional-param-syntax-removed.title: Runbook: register two routes (with and without the segment) or use an explicit optional-segment group path-to-regexp v8 actually supports, a source edit to the route string, never a mechanical drop-in for the old shorthand

res-send-number-status-drift.title: Runbook: use res.sendStatus(code) for a bare status code, res.send(...) for a real response body, a source edit that also makes the call's actual intent explicit
